record.name: Contract Maker: LegalDraft AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
LegalDraft AI turns any contract, agreement, or legal form into a five-minute task — no law degree required. Draft professional documents with AI, scan contracts for hidden risks before you sign, and get plain-English answers to your legal questions, all from your phone.

DRAFT ANY DOCUMENT IN MINUTES
Choose from 140+ professionally structured templates across 13 categories, tailored to your situation:

• Business & Commercial — NDAs, service agreements, partnerships, consulting contracts
• Employment — employment contracts, offer letters, termination letters
• Real Estate — leases, rental agreements, eviction notices, deeds
• Personal & Family — wills, powers of attorney, custody and child support agreements
• Financial — loan agreements, promissory notes, bills of sale, debt acknowledgments
• Technology & IP — software licenses, privacy policies, terms of service, SaaS contracts
• Healthcare — informed consent, HIPAA authorizations, medical releases
• Corporate Governance — board resolutions, bylaws, shareholder agreements
• E-commerce, media, education, and more

Pick the depth you need — Essential (2–4 pages), Professional (5–10 pages), or Comprehensive (10+ pages) — and export a polished PDF ready to share, print, or send for signing.

KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING
Upload any contract (PDF, DOCX, or TXT) and let AI show you what you'd otherwise miss:

• Risk scoring across financial, legal, operational, and compliance dimensions
• Clause-by-clause review with red flags and negotiation tips
• Document comparison — see every difference between two versions
• Plain-English translation — dense legalese, decoded instantly
• Smart summaries — the key points of a 30-page contract in seconds

ASK ANYTHING, ANYTIME
The built-in AI assistant answers questions about contracts, tenant rights, and legal procedures in clear language. Paste a confusing clause and get a simple explanation, the risks involved, and how to negotiate it — like having a knowledgeable friend who happens to read contracts for fun.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Freelancers protecting their work with airtight service agreements
• Landlords and tenants handling leases, notices, and disputes
• Small businesses that can't put an attorney on retainer
• Families preparing wills, POAs, and guardianship documents
• Anyone about to sign something they don't fully understand

PROFESSIONAL RESULTS
• Clean, court-ready formatting with your details filled in
• Editable output — refine any section before you export
• PDF export, printing, and sharing built in
• Available in 29 languages

Your documents stay on your device. Content is processed securely and is never used to train AI models.

LegalDraft AI provides information and document drafting assistance, not legal advice. For complex matters, consult a licensed attorney.

Download LegalDraft AI and handle the paperwork in minutes — so you can get back to what actually matters.

Note: LegalDraft AI provides AI-generated documents for informational purposes. For complex legal matters, consult a licensed attorney in your jurisdiction.

record.description_evidence:
Organize the facts. Review the document. Prepare the next step.

MatterPrep is a focused workspace for organizing a personal legal matter and using AI-assisted self-help tools with clear limits. It helps you collect facts, goals, notes, documents, action items, and questions in one place before you act or speak with a qualified professional.

ORGANIZE A MATTER
• Create a workspace for the facts, goal, notes, saved results, and next steps
• Use the workspace without an account; guest Matter data stays on that device
• Sign in when you want account-based sync and recovery
• Delete local Matter data or your account from Settings

AI-ASSISTED TOOLS FOR MEMBERS
• Matter chat to organize facts and questions
• Plain-English review of pasted text or a document photo you deliberately choose
• Editable factual letter drafts
• A practical legal-health checklist to surface items to review

AI tools require a signed-in account, your acknowledgement of the AI notice, and an active Apple-verified membership. Submitted text—and a selected document image only when you choose one—is sent through MatterPrep’s authenticated service to OpenAI. Remove sensitive identifiers before submitting content.

IMPORTANT LIMITS
MatterPrep provides general legal information, organization tools, and editable self-help drafts. It is not a lawyer or law firm, does not provide legal representation or legal advice, and does not create an attorney-client relationship. AI output may be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or inapplicable to your jurisdiction. Verify deadlines, rights, procedures, citations, and important decisions with official sources and a qualified local lawyer or legal-aid organization. Do not rely on MatterPrep for emergencies.

MEMBERSHIP
MatterPrep Weekly is an auto-renewable weekly subscription. Apple shows the current localized price and any eligible introductory offer before confirmation. Payment is charged to your Apple ID after you confirm. Membership renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Apple subscription settings. Deleting the app or your MatterPrep account does not cancel billing.

Terms of Use: https://pocketlawyer.io/terms
Support: https://pocketlawyer.io/support

AvvoGPT AI – Smart Legal Assistant for Lawyers

AvvoGPT AI is a next-generation legal assistant app built specifically for lawyers and legal professionals. It combines powerful AI tools into a single platform to help you manage legal documents, research, and communication more efficiently. Designed with simplicity and security in mind, AvvoGPT enhances your legal workflow without replacing your expertise.

The app includes a Document Analysis feature that allows you to upload any legal file and receive intelligent suggestions for changes. You can accept all changes at once or review them one by one, making it easy to maintain full control over your work while benefiting from advanced editing support.

With Live Document Scanning, you can use your phone’s camera to scan printed or handwritten legal documents. The app instantly converts images into editable text, making it convenient to digitize and work with physical paperwork wherever you are.

AvvoGPT AI includes a set of Legal Chatbots designed specifically for legal use. The app also features a Legal Search section that allows you to find articles, statutes, case law, and practice guides from a wide range of legal sources. You can search by keyword, topic, or jurisdiction, keeping all your legal research in one organized location.

In the Profile section, you can upload your own legal documents, templates, and references. These files can be easily accessed and used in combination with the app’s AI features, helping you save time and maintain consistency in your work.

At the core of the app is Avvo AI, a dedicated legal agent designed to support your daily tasks. Avvo AI can draft legal documents from scratch or based on your uploaded materials, compare contracts to highlight key differences, send professional emails, perform detailed legal research, and even respond vocally when needed. It works seamlessly with your personal files and preferences, helping you stay focused on high-value legal work.

Scan a lease, contract, or job offer and v-Lawyer reads it first, explaining every clause like a person, not a lawyer. Each red flag is tied to the exact line it comes from — so you can check the source yourself.

LegalDeep AI: Source-Backed Legal Research Assistant

LegalDeep AI is an AI-powered legal research companion built to help users ask legal questions, explore source-backed answers, review legal documents, and organize research threads from a mobile-first workspace. It is designed for legal research support, drafting support, document analysis, and faster issue spotting.

Ask about a legal issue, upload a document for context, review cited sources, and return to saved research history when you need to continue a matter or revisit prior work.

Built for Legal Research Workflows
LegalDeep AI can support attorneys, paralegals, law students, founders, compliance teams, small business operators, and individuals who need a clearer way to research legal information.

Core Tools

Source-Backed Legal Answers: Ask legal research questions and receive structured responses with citations and source references where available.

Document-Aware Analysis: Upload legal documents, contracts, pleadings, policies, correspondence, or PDFs and ask questions with that document context in mind.

Saved Research Threads: Return to prior questions, answers, documents, and cited sources.

Citation and Source Review: Inspect cited material and use source context to verify the answer before relying on it.

Legal Drafting Support: Brainstorm clauses, summarize documents, compare arguments, outline legal issues, or prepare research notes.

Research Planning: Break down complex questions into practical research paths, issue lists, authority checks, and follow-up questions.

Common Use Cases

LegalDeep AI can help with:
- Case law and statute research
- Contract review and clause explanation
- Litigation research and issue spotting
- Compliance and policy questions
- Business formation and startup legal research
- Employment, real estate, intellectual property, immigration, family law, estate planning, tax, and other research topics
- Summaries of pleadings, agreements, and other legal documents
- Drafting checklists, research memos, and follow-up questions

Important Disclaimer

LegalDeep AI is not a law firm, attorney, or substitute for professional legal advice. LegalDeep AI does not create an attorney-client relationship, does not represent users, and does not provide legal opinions.

Users are reminded that:
- AI-generated answers can be incomplete, outdated, or incorrect.

Source-first workflow: LegalDeep AI is built around research answers that can be checked against cited material.

Document context: Upload relevant files and ask questions that account for the contents of those documents.

Organized research: Saved threads help preserve context across research sessions.

record.description_evidence:
Legal questions come up in every part of life: family and divorce, work, housing, money and debts, purchases, immigration, copyright, traffic fines, criminal matters and much more. Describe your situation in plain words. Legal Mind explains where you stand under your local law and what to do next, reviews your documents for risks and drafts the letters you need.

LEGAL QUESTIONS
• Ask any legal question, big or small, in your own words.
• Get a clear, structured answer and practical next steps, without legal jargon.
• Keep each matter as a separate case and come back to it anytime.
• Attach photos, scans, PDF, Word or text files, or simply dictate.

DOCUMENT REVIEW
• Upload any contract or agreement: leases, employment and service contracts, NDAs, loan and purchase agreements, terms and conditions.
• See an overall score out of 10 and a clear verdict: Low risk, Needs attention or High risk.
• Understand the key risks, what each one means for you, and a plain-language summary.
• Ask follow-up questions in the chat and share the report as a PDF.

LETTERS
• Get demand letters, complaints, appeals and official requests drafted for your situation.
• Edit the text, then copy or share it. You decide what to send.

LOCAL LAW
• Choose from 50+ countries and every US state, or General law.
• Answers follow the jurisdiction you pick for each case.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-up.
• Your cases are stored encrypted on your device.
• We don't sell your data or show ads, and your content isn't used to train AI models.

Works on iPhone and iPad.

PREMIUM
Premium unlocks unlimited chats and document reviews (fair use applies). It is an auto-renewing weekly or annual subscription, charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://andrey-techalf.github.io/legalmind-docs/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://andrey-techalf.github.io/legalmind-docs/privacy.html
Apple's Standard EULA also applies.

Legal Mind is an AI tool that provides general legal information, not legal advice. It is not a law firm and is not a substitute for the advice of an attorney.
